requirement: Return every live antibiotic as an ID and name pair, sorted by name ascending and read without tracking; soft-deleted antibiotics are excluded by the query filter.

preconditions.text: The antibiotic table contains the rows seeded for the case
One of the seeded antibiotics is soft-deleted

inputs.text: Query with no parameters over three antibiotics inserted out of order
Query with no parameters over one live and one soft-deleted antibiotic
Query with no parameters on an empty database

returns.text: Success with ApplicationStatus.Success and a non-null result
Antibiotics sorted by name ascending, each carrying its own ID
Soft-deleted antibiotics are excluded from the list
An empty list is returned when no live antibiotic exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
